listingTitle: DK177 2 Pack Led Branch Light Battery Operated Lighted Branch Vase Filler Willow Tree Artificial Little Twig Power Brown 30 Inch 20 LED for Home Romantic Decoration, Warm White
listingLines: 【 Indoor Outdoor Decorations】 -- Handcrafted branch lights are cozy look, great for home and office decoration. Festival like christmas, valentines day, Christmas, events, showrooms, galleries, hallway, and any room. Create a relax, warm atmosphere.

【 DIY Crafting】 -- Lighted Branches are bendable, iron twig branch wires easy to shape. Adjust stems with lights to create your own natural look. Put the led branch lights into the vase, They shine nicely at night, enjoy a quiet night together with your love partner.

【 Safe and Easy Use】 -- Battery power willow twig lights require 2 AA battery, 3V input voltage. Completely safe for operation. The cord can be hid in the plant pot, avoid the annoying AC cord connection. Willow branch light add elegance of your house.

【 Specification】 -- Each decorative willow twig lights comes with 5 bendable stems, 30 inches total length, and 20 led warm white light bulbs. 2 packs of branch lights together to make the foliage look more lush.
【 EXCELLENT DECORATION】-- This branch with lights is great for home and office decoration. It looks gorgeous when put together with your beautiful, romantic flowers.（Need to prevent battery work）
summary: These LED branch lights offer a warm, romantic ambiance for your home. They provide a decorative touch that can be shaped to fit your personal style, solving the need for unique and atmospheric lighting in various indoor and outdoor settings.
